title: Fear & Cubes
body:
![Fear & Cubes](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/90b38f346a49ebb5f8ec917de99770d8e760c6da.png)


This is a texture pack inspired by weapons from Fear & Hunger and Termina. All models and textures were handmade, so these are not sprites taken directly from the games. To obtain the weapons, you simply need to rename them at an anvil. This pack includes:

# Miasma
![Miasma](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/50d8303baeaeb9c2acbb05348b295548196d07fe.png)
# Blue Sin
![Blue Sin](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/923b48cede8f020da03b2ce4e618fb8e43fd1145.png)
# Red Virtue
![Red Virtue (The_Iagle favorite weapon)](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b9cf94c8531a300828b53936fdb804ee1881385c.png)
# Black Steel
![Black Steel (ImaDuck_ favorite weapon)](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bdb1a3725613422003f56e48112b2c8a85ca8542.png)
# Blood Sword
![Blood Sword](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c9bd57b5e29fb2b4bbdbf6e9812c4113a7ef1f17.png)
# Sandman's kiss
![Sandman´s kiss](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/73eb8fa7f965a52fe1cc68d96c294a72ba7602a8.png)

Note: It only works with the Netherite Sword and the Mace, and it requires the exact names shown. For now, I have only added 6 weapons, but in the future, I plan to add more from Termina and, hopefully, the update promised to us 3000 years ago.
